label: A CONTINGENT_1 actual concrete being refutes concrete necessitarianism (NECESSARY_2)
description: The node's witness exists at w and is absent at an accessible world, so it is not NECESSARY_2; hence not every actual concrete being is. The rival is the exact contradictory of the node, so this refutation uses no modal-library law; it records the incompatibility. It fails without the node (CONTINGENT-NODE-CONTROLS, one-world frame).
